text:
Matt Barge, Claude Code session, 2026-10-15:
"Go ahead on 1", accepting the recommendation: "Hold our checks to a precision standard: every agent-filed ticket closes with a resolution kind, precision is reported weekly per check, a check below a bar is paused, and a check that fires across many pages in one run becomes one ticket."

Applied with the first precision report (tests/telemetry-report.mjs, tickets filed 2026-09-17 to 2026-10-15, the 28-day window):
- campus-info-packet-link-reachable (row campus.resources.packet.reachable): 18 filed, 0 ended in a change or decision, 18 false positive. Paused.
- public-event-sync (row site.events.sync.public): 12 filed, 0 ended in a change or decision, 5 false positive. Paused. Events are owned by Hailey McSpadden, not the website operators.
- images-render (row site.layout.images.render): 49 filed, 0% precision, but caused by the observer's runner (aeo PR 85) and now covered by the spike rule. Not paused, so a real broken image (404) still files.
- campus-page-stale-launch-media (row campus.intro.media.current): 15 filed, 0% in the window, but its 10 open tickets are real asks waiting on approved open-campus media. Not paused.
